exposure: therapeutic rest with paracetamol, triazolam and codeine
cohort: Nulliparous singleton pregnant women in the latent phase of labor presenting at the labor ward at Aarhus University Hospital, Denmark from May 13, 2018 to June 1, 2021
finding: This study found no significant association between therapeutic rest and neonatal admission or resuscitation.
mod_finding: This study found that therapeutic rest in the latent phase of labor was not associated with an increased risk of cesarean delivery.
